title: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers | TechCrunch
summary: Nuclear power startups have been pitching themselves as the antidote to what ails AI data centers: power that’s always available. To ramp quickly, TerraPower doesn’t increase or decrease the power output of its reactor.
